effect_description_eng:
While you have a Tamer with [Matt Ishida] in its name, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] By placing 1 [Garurumon] and 1 [WereGarurumon] from your trash as 1 of your [Gabumon]'s bottom digivolution cards, that Digimon may digivolve into [MetalGarurumon] in your hand, ignoring its digivolution requirements and without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect You may play 1 [Gabumon] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
